**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, VA, a school bus was involved in a three-vehicle crash on October 12 with minor injuries to one student and one driver; the at-fault driver was charged with reckless driving. Mercer County, WV, authorities arrested Derek Bailey, 25, of Lashmeet on charges related to the alleged sexual abuse of a child over more than two years; he is held on $80,000 cash-only bond. A statue of Tazewell native and Baseball Hall of Famer Billy Wagner will be unveiled October 17 at 3 p.m. on Main Street in Tazewell. No active NWS alerts or major hazards reported in the core area.[[1]](https://www.lootpress.com/mercer-county-man-accused-of-sexually-abusing-child-over-two-years/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core**  
- **Lashmeet, Mercer County, WV**: Derek Bailey, 25, is accused of repeatedly sexually abusing a child over more than two years (July 2023–December 2025) at a Lashmeet residence, beginning when the child was 12. The Mercer County Sheriff’s Office investigated after a report on September 1, 2026; evidence includes messages and a forensic interview. Bailey is in jail on an $80,000 cash-only bond. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.lootpress.com/mercer-county-man-accused-of-sexually-abusing-child-over-two-years/)[[1]](https://www.lootpress.com/mercer-county-man-accused-of-sexually-abusing-child-over-two-years/)

**Region**  
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core**  
- **North Tazewell, Tazewell County, VA**: On October 12 at approximately 3:51 p.m., a three-vehicle crash involving Tazewell County Public Schools Bus 71 occurred when a third vehicle struck a stopped car behind the bus, pushing it into the bus. Twenty-six children were on the bus; one student and the driver of the stopped car were transported with non-life-threatening injuries. The at-fault driver was charged with reckless driving and released with a summons. Responders included Virginia State Police, Town of Tazewell Fire Department, and EMS. TCPS stated all students were evaluated by EMS. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/) [source](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-public-schools-releases-statement-about-school-bus-accident/)[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-public-schools-releases-statement-about-school-bus-accident/)
